* '''Original''' ([[Baze Malbus With Cannon]]): Virtual Set 7 release ([[Virtual Set 7]]); Players Committee card image<ref name="ht0">[https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual7-Light/large/bazemalbuswithcannon.gif bazemalbuswithcannon.gif] in the PC's Holotable image repository (the images served at res.starwarsccg.org), commit 022435b "Set 9 load", 8 July 2018.</ref>: “If about to be lost, may fire Baze's Cannon. * '''PC-E1''' ([[Baze Malbus With Cannon (Errata)]]): Players Committee card image<ref name="ht1">[https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/a57375eaf483d0e05592c08185b77505a415f0e5/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual7-Light/large/bazemalbuswithcannon.gif bazemalbuswithcannon.gif] in the PC's Holotable image repository (the images served at res.starwarsccg.org), commit a57375e "Fixing case and making gifs", 4 November 2022.</ref>: “If about to be lost, may fire Baze's Cannon. Permanent weapon is •Baze's Cannon (may target a character for free; draw destiny; add 1 if targeting a character of ability < 3; target hit, and its forfeit = 0, if destiny +1 > defense value).” '''What changed:''' the card was re-rendered at higher resolution, and “destiny + 1” is now set as “destiny +1” (space removed). A version because the change is visible on the card (Bill, 12 November 2026). No errata mark. The card prints the errata mark “none” although this is change 1 in release order: a PC transcription error in the mark (Bill, 12 November 2026: number versions by release order and record the printed mark).
